old_deck.description: The deck the added blocks were written against (its numbering is what they point at). It may *INCLUDE other files; the whole closure must be readable.

new_deck.description: The re-meshed deck. It may *INCLUDE other files; the whole closure must be readable. Its integer field width must equal old_deck's.

entities.description: A .k file holding only the blocks we added (sets of nodes, segments, parts and elements, SPC, loads, history, CNRB, rigid-body merges, contacts, mass, coordinate nodes, curves, boxes, part damping, initial stress). It is not changed.

output.description: The re-bound blocks, to be *INCLUDEd together with new_deck. Must differ from entities.

range_diff.description: Optional StepForge range table (range_diff JSON). Each part's coord_sha is checked on both decks.

tolerance.description: Optional coordinate tolerance (model length unit). 0 or absent means exact match only. A positive value matches a node without an exact partner to the single new node of the same part within this distance; it must be at least 0.

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
